card.name: Start of antagonist and inadvertent words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word beginning with "ant" or "inad", right before the rest of the word is spelled out. Seen in "antagonist", "antibiotics" and "inadvertent" or "inadvisable".

modes.label: Antagonist
modes.description: The "Ant" or "nt" piece just before "agonist" in receptor antagonist and agonist/antagonist terms.
modes.example: Mixed Agonist/A<<nt>>agonist and Partial Agonist O

modes.label: Inadvertent / inadvisable
modes.example: THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF IN<<AD>>VERTENT INTRAVENOUS ADMIN

modes.label: Antibiotics in capitals
modes.description: The "ANT" piece starting "ANTIBIOTICS" in all-caps text.
modes.example: PENICILLIN-SENSITIVE PATIENTS.<< ANT>>IBIOTICS SHOULD BE ADMINISTER

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated pieces such as "over", "counter" and "备".
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of long words like antagonist, antibiotics and inadvertent, before the word is finished.
